description: This Java test source file contains unit tests for the IfNoneMatchPreconditionHeader class, which is part of the HTTP headers handling in the Eclipse Ditto project. The tests verify immutability, behavior of key and value retrieval, condition checking mechanisms with entity tags, and extraction from DittoHeaders.

classes.name: IfNoneMatchPreconditionHeaderTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class testing the functionality of the IfNoneMatchPreconditionHeader class, including immutability, key/value retrieval, condition logic, and header extraction.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that instances of IfNoneMatchPreconditionHeader are immutable.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Tests that getKey() returns the correct header key 'if-none-match'.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Tests that getValue() returns the correct entity tag string.

methods.name: doesNotMeetConditionForEqualOpaqueTag
methods.description: Verifies that identical opaque tags do not meet the condition.

methods.name: meetsConditionForNull
methods.description: Checks that null entity tags meet the condition.

methods.name: asteriskMeetsConditionForNull
methods.description: Ensures that an asterisk (*) meets condition when null.

methods.name: asteriskDoesNotMeetConditionForNonNull
methods.description: Ensures that an asterisk (*) does not meet condition for non-null entity tags.

methods.name: ListMeetsConditionIfNotContained
methods.description: Verifies that a list of tags meets the condition if a specific tag is not contained.

methods.name: ListDoesNotMeetConditionIfContained
methods.description: Verifies that a list of tags does not meet the condition if a specific tag is contained.

methods.name: fromDittoHeaders
methods.description: Tests extraction of IfNoneMatchPreconditionHeader from DittoHeaders.

methods.name: createIfNoneMatchPreconditionHeader
methods.description: Helper method to create an instance of IfNoneMatchPreconditionHeader for testing.
